tara: hi all, tara here — first day. building runtime from source with clang as our host compiler and getting unresolved nvrtc symbols at link time. any ideas?

tara: build command: `cmake -B build -S . -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ && cmake --build build -j8`

tara: link error snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: build/lib/libjit.a(jit_nvrtc.o): in function `compile_ptx':
jit_nvrtc.o: undefined reference to `nvrtcCreateProgram'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

omar: welcome! :wave: nvrtc symbols are in libnvrtc.so. Did cmake find nvrtc and add -lnvrtc to the link line? can you paste `build/link_command.txt` or the final link line?

tara: `build/link_command.txt` shows `-L/usr/local/cuda/lib64 -lcudart -lcublas -lstdc++` but no `-lnvrtc`. weirdly, `pkg-config --libs nvrtc` on my host returns nothing.

lucas: we usually rely on the CUDA toolkit providing libnvrtc; on some distros you need a separate dev package (libnvrtc-dev) or use the runfile toolkit. also when using clang as host compiler, nvcc may need `-ccbin clang++-14` to generate compatible object ABI. try running `scripts/setup_cuda.sh` to set CUDA_HOME and reconfigure cmake with `-DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=$CUDA_HOME`.

tara: i ran the setup script and it set CUDA_HOME to /usr/local/cuda-12.2 but `ldconfig -p | grep nvrtc` shows nothing. 

omar: that suggests your system toolchain doesn't have the nvrtc dev symlinks. If you installed CUDA via distro packages it can be missing. Quick fix: install the toolkit runfile or the distro package that provides libnvrtc.so and headers. On Ubuntu that’s `sudo apt install libnvrtc12 libnvrtc-dev` (name varies).

tara: installed `libnvrtc-dev` and re-ran cmake; now `-lnvrtc` appears in link line but link still fails complaining about C++ ABI mismatches (unmangled symbol warnings) when linking nvrtc C++ callbacks. error: `undefined reference to __cxa_demangle` etc.

lucas: clang vs nvcc interplay — best to make nvcc invoke the same host compiler. reconfigure cmake with `-DCUDA_HOST_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++-14` or set `NVCC_WRAPPER_FLAGS=--ccbin=clang++-14`. Also ensure you build libstdc++/libc++ consistently; our repo uses libstdc++ so use clang++ with `-stdlib=libstdc++`.

tara: set `-DCUDA_HOST_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++-14` and added `-stdlib=libstdc++` to CXX flags, rebuilt. final link succeeded and runtime tests that use the JIT succeed. :tada:

omar: sweet. could you add a small troubleshooting note under docs/dev-setup.md about needing libnvrtc-dev and setting CUDA_HOST_COMPILER when using clang? we had one or two folks hit this already.

infra-bot: Reminder: if you modified system packages, please add your host OS/toolkit combo to the onboarding spreadsheet and confirm license compliance.

onboard-bot: Welcome tara! Please complete the "Runtime dev setup" checklist in Notion and claim a mentor.

tara: will do, thanks so much for the help everyone!
_description: Onboarding thread: new hire sees undefined nvrtc symbols when building runtime with clang; team recommends installing libnvrtc-dev, running setup script, ensuring -lnvrtc is linked, and configuring CUDA_HOST_COMPILER/ccbin and C++ stdlib for clang compatibility.
